description: This file declares the RequestHandler class within the WPEFramework::Plugin namespace. The class manages lifecycle operations such as launch, terminate, sendIntent, and updateState, and provides access to component handlers like RuntimeManagerHandler, WindowManagerHandler, and IEventHandler. It also enforces singleton pattern by deleting copy constructor and providing a static getInstance method.

classes.name: RequestHandler
classes.description: A singleton class responsible for managing lifecycle requests and component handlers within the plugin framework.

methods.name: RequestHandler
methods.description: Private constructor to enforce singleton pattern.

methods.name: getInstance
methods.description: Returns the singleton instance of RequestHandler.

methods.name: initialize
methods.description: Initializes the request handler with the service shell and event handler.

methods.name: terminate
methods.description: Terminates the request handler and releases resources.

methods.name: launch
methods.description: Launches an application with the specified context and intent, targeting a specific lifecycle state.

methods.name: terminate
methods.description: Terminates an application with the specified context, with an option to force termination.

methods.name: sendIntent
methods.description: Sends an intent within the application context.

methods.name: updateState
methods.description: Updates the lifecycle state of an application.

methods.name: getRuntimeManagerHandler
methods.description: Returns the runtime manager handler instance.

methods.name: getWindowManagerHandler
methods.description: Returns the window manager handler instance.
